card.name: Inside lacosamide and antiarrhythmic lists
card.fires_on: The middle piece 'acos' inside the drug name lacosamide, and the comma or 'e.g.' just before quinidine and procainamide in lists of Class IA antiarrhythmics. Rarely on wire-size numbers like 3/0 AWG.
